source: curated by hand (2026-11-03, mcp-server.md §12.9) from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on linux, 2026-11-03 and the evidence listed
summary: Drum multi-effect rack: six serial slots, each any of 21 effects (bitcrush, drive, filters, ring mod, comb, stutter, delay, reverb, gate, tuned resonator…), with feedback, an envelope follower, a tempo-synced LFO and a scene morph. For mangling and texturing drums.
quirks: All slots are None at the defaults: it passes sound unchanged until a slot's Type and Amount are set.
A slot's Char and Mode mean different things per effect; their value texts (machine_describe) say what they do for the loaded effect.
Stereo in, stereo out; Delay, Stutter and LFO times are in ticks, so they follow the song's tempo.
Feedback routes the rack's output back to its input; the output limiter (on by default) keeps it in bounds.
evidence: ExternalMachines/source/thepedal/pedal-drum-matrix/README.md — slots, effects, Char and Mode per effect, feedback, LFO, resonator, morph
ExternalMachines/source/thepedal/pedal-drum-matrix/PedalDrumMatrix.cs — parameters, DescribeValue scaling (FbTime, FbTone, EnvRelease, depths), LfoTicks
